CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Provides the reporting timestamp, when the report was submitted from the CSD to the Competent Authority.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Specifies the currency used to report the aggregated values of the transactions.||Usage: this is the currency in which the values have to be reported, when no explicit currency is provided.

ReportStatus.name: Report Status
ReportStatus.definition: Provides the status of the report.

SecuritiesSettlementSystem.name: Securities Settlement System
SecuritiesSettlementSystem.definition: Specifies the securities settlement system used in a settlement process.
